Ordinary & Special Meetings of Council

	
                    


    



 
Council Meeting Timetable
The Flinders Ranges Council, pursuant to Section 81 of the Local Government Act 1999, has determined the Ordinary Meeting schedule for the 2022-2026 Council term at the first meeting of Council held on Thursday 22 November 2022.
Council is scheduled to meet every 3rd Tuesday of the month at 6:30pm at the Quorn Administration Office, 1 Seventh Street, Quorn SA 5433 in January, February, April, May, July, August, October & November and at Foresters Hall, 72 Cradock Road, Hawker SA 5434 in March, June, September & December.
